topic: root cause of compat-wiring proof gap (r14-mutation-recovery-1): 279 consumer call sites of credited compatibility files survive bypass
decision: PROXIMATE: compat-mutation-proof renames legacy names inside credited files and requires only the credited file's own spec to fail; consumers that stop calling the credited function leave every test green. SYSTEMIC: (1) ledger coveringTest ties a credit to the credited file's unit test, never to a behavioural test through its consumer; (2) consumer tests use canonical fixtures or never render the consumer (hooks bypassed to undefined survive); (3) bypass returns the first argument, a truthy value, so nominal assertions pass and only negative-path tests kill (roleLevel->string makes 'level < required' a NaN comparison = fail-open in ai.controller:21, rbac-admin:144/206/363); (4) credit is per file not per legacy symbol (73/304 sites call non-legacy functions); (5) no reachability check (25 sites are dead/draft code); (6) harness hid kills: classifyRun false INCONCLUSIVE x22 (thrown TypeError in a loaded suite is a kill), 3 BASELINE_RED were load flakiness (re-run green, bypass killed), migrations testDir misses database/*.migration.spec.ts. TRIAGE: 304 sites = 209 REAL_COMPAT, 43 COSMETIC, 25 UNREACHABLE (15 unregistered gated draft migration, 4 dead artists.form-contract.ts, 3 dead transaction-constants helpers, 2 test-only contract-variables.ts, 1 dead useCanAccess.ts), 25 ENVIRONMENT, 2 EQUIVALENT (transaction.validator.ts:165/166, proven idempotent after z.preprocess). DETECTION GAP: found only by the third independent mutation review. PREVENTION (deterministic): per-consumer *.legacy-wiring tests with negative paths killing every REAL_COMPAT/COSMETIC site under compat-wiring-proof --check; classifyRun counts per-test thrown errors of a loaded suite as KILLED (load/compile errors stay INCONCLUSIVE); baseline retry before BASELINE_RED; moduleDirOf for database/migrations -> database; reachability gate from main.ts/main.tsx plus deletion of dead credited consumers; credit by exported symbol. No gate weakened. Triage: scratchpad wiring-triage.json
